remarks: Spectacular, sun-filled riverfront end unit townhouse with 3-4BR, 2.5 BA this beautifully maintained home offers 3,395 sq. ft. on three finished levels. The light-filled main level features hardwood floors, LR w/wood burning fireplace, and an updated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. A private deck with retractable awning extends the main living space outdoors. The main level office can easily be a 4th BR or guest room. Upstairs, the generously sized primary suite includes an en-suite bath, walk in closet and additional storage. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the upstairs. The finished walkout lower level is perfect for a family room, gym, or guest suite with a deck overlooking the Five Mile River. Other features include central air, central vac, and a detached garage with additional parking onsite. Canaan Close offers beautifully landscaped grounds, a heated pool and a sought after lushly landscaped welcoming community. Prime location within walking distance to downtown, the Metro-North train (with Express service to Grand Central in about an hour) and top-rated New Canaan schools. A rare opportunity for low-maintenance, turnkey living in a peaceful and convenient setting!
